big.h: Nvidia board opens independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang

facts: Nvidia's board opened an independent probe after reports that Jensen Huang was the target of a foreign intelligence effort.
A US government memo reported by the Financial Times links Huang romantically to a Megaspeed executive US intelligence believes is a Chinese spy.
In an email to staff Huang apologized for being unfaithful to his wife and said he'll cooperate fully.
The board says it has no reason to believe national security or Nvidia secrets were compromised; Huang stays on as CEO.
brief.why: The probe lands 8 days before Nvidia's earnings, and the stock opened about 8% lower.
